name: killed-host
description: One entity with an afterCreate webhook, for a host that is killed between the commit and the delivery. The endpoint URL below is a placeholder: ChildHostHarness rewrites it to the loopback receiver's own port before the child process reads this file, and refuses to start if the rewrite matched nothing.

orders.description: An order, so a create has an event to emit.

order-sink.description: Port 9 is discard: this URL is only ever the placeholder the harness rewrites, so a child started with the file as it sits on disk delivers nowhere instead of somewhere unexpected.
